messages:
alex_k: Customer hit a sudden SSO failure after IdP cert rotate — their app sees a 400 on ACS with 'Signature verification failed'. They say nothing changed on their end except the IdP rotated keys earlier today. attaching logs in next msg

maya_chen: can you drop the IdP metadata (EntityDescriptor) and the ACS URL they configured? also which SP entityID we exposed to them?

alex_k: SP entityID we gave them is: https://app.redwood.com/saml/metadata
IdP entityID in customer metadata (pasted):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.examplecorp.com/sso?realm=acme">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="encryption">...X509Data...</KeyDescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">...X509Data (new cert)...</KeyDescriptor>
    <!-- Note: signing key is SECOND here -->
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
They also sent an ACS URL: `https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs` (no trailing slash).

samir_r: hmm, two red flags: 1) entityID contains a query param `?realm=acme` — we historically did exact string match but we also started normalizing by dropping query params in a recent patch. 2) KeyDescriptor ordering: our parser currently picks the first KeyDescriptor for signature validation in some codepaths. If the IdP put signing second and encryption first we might pick the wrong public key.

jen_prod: did they rotate to a new cert chain (ECDSA vs RSA) or just swapped certs? any thumbprints? customer said new cert is SHA256 thumbprint `AB:12:...`

alex_k: new cert is RSA2048, SHA256. reproduced locally with their metadata. Repro steps:
```bash
# simulate SAML POST as IdP would
curl -X POST \ 
  -F "SAMLResponse=$(cat sample_response.b64)" \ 
  "https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs" -v
# response: HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
# body: Signature validation failed
```

eng-oncall-bot: Incident created: RED-7891 — SAML signature failures after IdP cert rotation (linked ticket)

maya_chen: can we confirm whether our metadata matcher is dropping the query param? if so, it might cause an entityID mismatch (we might be routing to the wrong IdP record or the wrong KeyDescriptor). Also check whether we perform KeyDescriptor selection by `use` or by order.

samir_r: looked at the runtime: matcher_normalize_entityid() strips query params and fragment (intended), but there is an edge-case where the canonicalization runs twice leading to a normalization loop that can produce an alternate cache key. also the signature-verifier code does `for key in descriptor.keys: use_first_key()` — it doesn't prefer `use="signing"` reliably. so if signing is second, we may try encryption key and fail. i can reproduce by swapping order in the metadata.

alex_k: customer confirmed they uploaded metadata from a vendor tool that reorders KeyDescriptor. they temporarily fixed by re-exporting metadata with signing KeyDescriptor first. they validated SSO flow and it works.

jen_prod: thanks. proposed short-term mitigation: update our importer to re-order descriptors to prefer `use="signing"` when present, and add a matcher that compares entityIDs after both raw and normalized forms (to avoid double-normalization mismatch).

maya_chen: agree. @samir_r can you scope the code fix + test? we should also add a diagnostic to our SSO support tool that warns if the IdP metadata has duplicate EntityDescriptor or non-standard entityID forms (query params, trailing slash variance).

samir_r: on it — estimate 2d for patch + tests. i'll include a migration to prefer KeyDescriptor with `use="signing"` and fall back to `ds:X509Data` parse if KeyValue present. i'll link a repro unit test using the customer's sample metadata.

alex_k: i told the customer the workaround (re-export with signing first) and asked them to keep their support window open while we patch. they replied :thumbsup: and will wait for the fix.

eng-oncall-bot: RED-7891 updated: assignee samir_r, priority P2, linked PR pending

alex_k: adding one more note for docs: include guidance that IdP metadata should list `KeyDescriptor use="signing"` before `encryption` where possible, and that entityID matching should be consistent. will draft a short KB article.

maya_chen: please attach customer's sanitized metadata to the ticket and close once PR deployed + customer verifies.

alex_k: done — attaching sanitized metadata and repro steps to RED-7891. will follow up when staging deploys the patch.

samir_r: final note — we'll also add a runtime metric for 'saml_key_selection_mismatch' to catch similar issues after future rotations.

alex_k: thanks everyone, closing this thread once customer confirms in ~24h :handshake:
